subject.title: Built-in skill 'summarize' only supports brew install, no feedback when enable fails

question: Should OpenClaw keep summarize as a bundled skill, and if so what supported installer and platform contract should it advertise?
rationale: The deleted formula is proven, but choosing a replacement source, platform support boundary, or removal/de-bundling is a product and supply-chain ownership decision.

options.title: Gate or de-bundle until verified
options.body: Mark summarize unsupported or remove it from bundled skills until maintainers verify a maintained installer source and ownership path.

options.title: Keep bundled with a verified installer
options.body: Update the manifest to a maintained install source and add UI/status tests and real Linux/Docker proof for that supported path.

options.title: Keep brew-only with explicit messaging
options.body: Declare the skill macOS/Homebrew-only and make the list/detail UI and docs explain the requirement before enable/install attempts.

recommendation.title: Gate or de-bundle until verified
recommendation.body: Mark summarize unsupported or remove it from bundled skills until maintainers verify a maintained installer source and ownership path.

likelyOwner.reason: The summarize skill and installer metadata history is centered on steipete's commits, making him the clearest routing candidate for the bundled-skill decision.
